note: Product specification only; this catalog does not assert that these applications or capabilities are implemented or shipped.

applications.name: Cockos
boundaries: Visible microphone permission and recording state
Per-application control depends on host audio-session support
Not specified as a professional DAW or hidden recorder

applications.name: Kavun
boundaries: Slices are logical groups and need not duplicate source files
Location and image indexing are user-controllable
Private media metadata requires privacy controls

applications.name: Ka-bon
boundaries: Extracted values require user confirmation
No payment execution or automatic transfers are specified
Financial and family data require explicit access controls

applications.name: Gloverty
boundaries: Rules expose triggers actions scope and enabled state
Privileged or destructive actions require permission and confirmation
Loop prevention and failure behavior are required

applications.name: Po
boundaries: Tracker protection is not anonymity
Site permissions and private browsing state must be understandable
Commands must be distinguishable from URLs and searches

applications.name: Illidia
boundaries: Cloud saves require a compatible provider and conflict handling
Clip capture and sharing require user control
Do Not Disturb must be reversible

applications.name: Unify
boundaries: Pairing must be authenticated and revocable
Sharing permissions are configurable per data type
Lost-device discovery is not guaranteed live location tracking

prototype.scope: Interactive local prototype. It is not a native DuckOS system application or proof of integration with OS services.

cockos: Microphone recording and local track import/mixdown are available where browser media APIs permit.
Per-application volume settings are stored as preferences and do not change OS audio sessions.
kavun: Local media import, event slices, metadata search and non-destructive preview/export are available.
Image understanding and automatic location recognition are not connected.
ka-bon: Local expense, receipt attachment, subscription and family-member records are available.
Receipt OCR, banking and cloud family sharing are not connected.
gloverty: Rules can be created, enabled and manually run against supported local actions.
OS-wide scheduling, input gestures and global shortcuts are not connected.
po: Tab records, external navigation and pasted-text reading view are available.
The network stack, browser-engine isolation and tracker blocking are not connected.
illidia: Local game catalogue, progress, achievements and user-authorized screen clips are available.
Native executable launch, cloud saves and platform achievement providers are not connected.
unify: Local clipboard APIs and manual JSON export/import for tabs, clips and selected settings are available.
Secure device pairing, live sync, phone notifications and lost-device discovery are not connected.

interfaces.scope: Manual export/import of selected browser tabs, user-selected clips and selected local settings; not live device synchronization.
